description: Extracts and validates all embedded application/ld+json blocks (including @graph trees) on a live page, flags syntax errors and missing AI-citation properties for Organization, WebSite, SoftwareApplication, Product, Article, FAQPage, and WebPage entities, scores schema completeness (0-100), and outputs a ready-to-paste JSON-LD @graph patch customized from detected metadata.

url.description: Public HTTPS/HTTP URL to audit live (e.g. https://example.com).

name: schema_citation_check

citationReadiness.description: Readiness classification for AI answer engine citations.

detectedTypes.description: Normalized Schema.org @type entities detected on the page.

finalUrl.description: Final audited page URL after redirects.

iceActionPlan.description: Prioritized schema and entity graph fixes.

jsonLdBlockCount.description: Total embedded application/ld+json script blocks found.

parseErrors.description: JSON syntax or structure errors in extracted JSON-LD blocks.

schemaScore.description: JSON-LD citation completeness score from 0 to 100.
